correctness.rationale: Two independent membership predicates agree on all 4096 masks. A complete exact reconstruction of the supplied 211 Morse pairs and topological sort of the directed 1428-cover Hasse diagram establish an acyclic matching on all 424 nonempty faces. Its unique critical zero- and three-cells force the CW type S3 integrally. Eight exhaustive graph automorphisms and signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz numbers force r=-1, s=+1 on rank-one integral H3. Independent modular boundaries corroborate but are not relied upon as integral proofs.

value.rationale: The graph is a canonical twelve-vertex four-regular triangle-free four-chromatic benchmark; its first higher-independence complex is a natural structural invariant. The complete integral homotopy classification S3 versus the known ordinary-independence S2 and the change of dihedral reflection orientation are substantial topological information, not mere numerical recomputation or arbitrary parameter tuning. Explicit matching makes the result reusable as a verified graph-complex example.
